definition.effective_dimension: participation ratio of the column-standardized correlation spectrum
definition.interaction_rank_constraint: Two-way centering gives each interaction row sum zero. Subsequent non-zero column scaling preserves one exact linear dependence, so interaction rank is at most P-1.

docking44.orientation: sign chosen so the mean target loading is positive

dockstring58.orientation: sign chosen so the mean target loading is positive

docking44_jackknife.estimand: delete-one-target composition sensitivity; the normal interval is a jackknife approximation for the observed target population

dockstring58_jackknife.estimand: delete-one-target composition sensitivity; the normal interval is a jackknife approximation for the observed target population

target_panel_uncertainty.interpretation: Intervals across target subsets describe composition sensitivity, not a probability sample of all drug targets. Stratification retains every broad family when the requested subset size permits.

dockstring_scaffold_bootstrap.scope: chemical-support and scaffold-cluster sensitivity across five independently seeded 15,000-molecule supports; conditional on the 58 observed targets

docking44.null: independently permute every target column, then apply the same raw or two-way-centered transformation; rank-wise counts are descriptive, while the studentized maximum-deviation envelope controls the family-wise error rate over ranks

dockstring58.null: independently permute every target column, then apply the same raw or two-way-centered transformation; rank-wise counts are descriptive, while the studentized maximum-deviation envelope controls the family-wise error rate over ranks

docking44.model: X_ij = fitted grand + fitted ligand effect_i + fitted target effect_j + independent Gaussian residual with the observed target-specific residual variance
docking44.interpretation: The null asks whether two-way centering alone creates the observed residual concentration. A residual PR below this null indicates correlated residual structure.

dockstring58.model: X_ij = fitted grand + fitted ligand effect_i + fitted target effect_j + independent Gaussian residual with the observed target-specific residual variance
dockstring58.interpretation: The null asks whether two-way centering alone creates the observed residual concentration. A residual PR below this null indicates correlated residual structure.

matched_raw_and_interaction_bootstrap.resampling_unit: ligand row, paired across docking and experiment

matched_target_preference_benchmark.primary_estimand: mean per-ligand pairwise target-preference accuracy over observed exact-relation median pChEMBL cells; exact experimental ties excluded
matched_target_preference_benchmark.sign_convention: fixed a priori from the Vina energy convention: more negative docking scores predict higher pChEMBL
matched_target_preference_benchmark.cross_fitting: leave one ligand out; target means, grand mean, raw target standard deviations, and residual target standard deviations estimated only from the other 73 ligands

multiple_imputation.method: 100 posterior draws from chained Bayesian-ridge regressions; imputed values bounded by the observed range of each target

matched_target_preference_benchmark.boundary: This six-target benchmark tests operational target ranking on one matched ChEMBL support; it does not estimate reverse-docking accuracy for other panels.

preprocessing_sensitivity.invariance_note: For a raw complete matrix, the correlation spectrum is algebraically invariant to non-zero affine rescaling of individual columns. Robust scaling matters only when performed before row-effect removal.

missing_data_estimators.interpretation: The experimental estimate remains above the docking reference under all tested missing-data models, but its magnitude is model-dependent: 2.644 with low-rank SoftImpute and 5.721--8.592 with KNN, PPCA or multiple imputation. The fully observed 31-by-6 sub-block has participation rank 3.608.

ledoit_wolf_sensitivity.note: Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage-covariance participation ratio vs ordinary sample PR. n >> p in every block, so the data-driven shrinkage is modest and the experimental effective dimension is essentially unchanged -- and stays ~2-fold (74x6) to ~3-fold (22-target) above the docking ~1.8 even under shrinkage that biases toward lower rank.

headline.empirical_shrinkage_direction: Because n >> p in every block the data-driven shrinkage is small (0.04-0.10) and, by regularising toward a scaled-identity target, it slightly FLATTENS the spectrum and nudges the participation ratio UP rather than down (74x6 exp 3.73->4.03; 22-target 5.72->6.39; 74x6 docking 1.83->1.96). The experimental block is therefore robustly ~2-fold (74x6) to ~3-fold (22-target) above docking under shrinkage -- the high experimental dimension is not a fragile artefact removable by covariance regularisation.
headline.si_sentence: A Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage-covariance participation ratio gives effective dimension 4.0 (74x6) / 6.4 (22-target), confirming the experimental block stays ~2-fold above docking even under shrinkage that biases toward lower rank.

reproducibility_calibrated_noise_injecti.interpretation_of_sigma: Estimated from repeated compound-target records reported in different documents; it includes inter-laboratory and condition variability and is therefore a conservative measurement-noise scale.

activity_level_curated_matched_blocks.selection: exact standard relation; Ki/Kd/IC50/EC50; full InChIKey; median over repeated compound-target activities; at least five of six targets

matched_physicochemical_residualization.cross_fitting: five-fold shuffled KFold, seed 0; one HistGBM per target

all_20_scorers_sensitivity.selection_warning: The outcome-restricted 12-arm sensitivity excludes eight chance-level arms on an outcome-related criterion. The 20-arm sensitivity is required to show the dependence of the association on that restriction.

precision_at_5_support.ceiling_definition: min(ceil(0.10 * n_measured_targets), 5) / 5; ties at the experimental decile threshold can only increase the number labelled relevant

dti_associations.provenance_warning: The 20 arms are heterogeneous model/configuration results, not independent draws. Association statistics are descriptive and must not be interpreted as population-level inference.

nonlinear_size_removed.note: GBM cross-fitted removal of 7 physchem descriptors; vs linear (2.54)

rfscore_vina_pose.interpretation: Across 14 diverse targets a machine-learning scoring function (RF-Score v1, trained on PDBbind crystal structures) yields effective rank 1.42 (PC1 84%), matching the Vina panel (1.25); the RF-Score PC1 aligns with Vina's (|r|=0.72). The low-rank collapse is therefore not specific to AutoDock-family empirical scoring but holds under a fundamentally different ML scoring paradigm.
rfscore_vina_pose.note_sign: per-target Spearman negative purely by convention (Vina lower=better, RF-Score higher=better); after sign alignment global r=+0.68

rfscore_vinardo_pose.interpretation: Across 20 diverse targets, RF-Score (ML) applied to NON-Vina (smina-vinardo) poses gives effective rank 1.81 (of 20; PC1 74%), still strongly low-rank and close to the original Vina panel (1.29); PC1 aligns |r|=0.81. The low-rank collapse survives non-Vina pose generation + ML scoring on a larger panel.

target_expansion.interpretation: If the 3 purpose-added hepatic targets carried independent mechanism, n_signal and effective rank would rise by up to 3 and each would correlate weakly with the panel mean. Observed below.

effective_rank.interpretation: if rank stays ~2 after removing size, the collapse is a deeper general binding factor; if it rises, molecular size IS the dominant collapse axis.

matched_bootstrap.interpretation: Same 74 compounds, 6 co-measured targets, complete data: docking eff-dim 1.827 (95% CI [1.6, 2.14]) vs experimental 3.734 ([2.93, 4.37]); difference 1.815 (95% CI [1.05, 2.61], p<=0: 0.0). The six aminergic targets are highly co-correlated in docking (mean |r|=0.66) but less so in experiment (0.31), which is why docking collapses to ~1.8 even here.

docking_maskedImputed_floor_likeExp.note: experimental mask + FLOOR-impute applied to a genuinely rank-1.8 docking block; the estimate INFLATES far above the true docking rank -- sparse-mask floor-imputation manufactures dimensionality, which is why we do NOT anchor on the floor-imputed experimental value (10.3) and report the imputation-robust KNN estimate instead.

docking_maskedImputed_KNN_likeExp.note: experimental mask + KNN-impute applied to docking; stays near the true docking rank, so KNN does NOT manufacture dimensionality and the experimental KNN estimate is trustworthy.

bootstrap_diff_expKNN_minus_dock.note: imputation-robust experimental eff-rank minus matched-22-target docking eff-rank

pocket_geometry_rigor.note: small-n (~36) regression; OOS R2 is the honest estimate, in-sample R2=0.45 is optimistic
